thread:
nora: Heads-up: proposing two partner-facing breaking changes next quarter: 1) batch payload moves from array "items" to keyed object "requests_map" (reduces ambiguity for large batch retries), 2) deprecate "X-Partner-Signature" header in favor of standard Bearer auth. Need partner plan.

sam: Can you sketch the payload diff? we should show tiny migration snippet for marketplace images.

nora: Sure, old -> new example below. We'll include polyfills in SDKs but market images + SI connectors must release.

kevin: Quick note: the auth header change impacts a bunch of installer scripts that still rely on the legacy header. That's mostly marketplace install hooks and 3 SI adapters.

isabelle: Suggest a compatibility flag: set header "X-Compat-Mode: legacy" for runtime to accept legacy X-Partner-Signature for 8 weeks. Partners can opt-in while they ship.

partner-bot: New runbook created -> https://console.redwood.com/partners/batch-auth-migration (auto-tagged #marketplace #compat)

sam: Sample diff for docs (inline):
```json
// OLD
{
  "items": [
    { "id": "a1", "input": "..." },
    { "id": "b2", "input": "..." }
  ],
  "X-Partner-Signature": "sha256=..."
}

// NEW
{
  "requests_map": {
    "a1": { "input": "..." },
    "b2": { "input": "..." }
  }
}
```

kevin: Also add note: each request now MUST include id in requests_map keys. That will break any code that relies on implicit ordering.

isabelle: Rollout proposal: announce (week 0), SDK polyfills + quickstart (week 1), partner canaries + marketplace image builds (weeks 2-6), deprecate legacy header for new requests (week 8), remove acceptance of legacy header (week 14). Stagger marketplace -> SI -> on-prem.

nora: I'm OK with stagger. We should require canary health checks before removing legacy header. Metrics: error rate < 0.3% and median parsing time within +15% baseline for 72h.

sam: Ops will implement server-side compat flag behind feature flag per tenant. It will log usage of legacy header so we can ping partners still hitting it.

kevin: Action items: @sam add feature flag + logging by Tue EOD, @isabelle draft partner outreach + FAQ by Wed, @nora compile stoplight matrix (red/yellow/green) and list of images by Wed.

isabelle: FAQ should include: npm/pip commands for new SDK, tiny shim example, marketplace rebuild checklist, and rollback instructions. I'll include a short script partners can vendor to translate old array -> map for a short runway.

sam: We'll ship SDK polyfills with commands in docs: `npm install @redwood/partner-shim` and `pip install redwood-partner-shim`. Polyfill exposes `migrateBatch(items)` helper.

partner-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled Fri 09:30 for removal gating review.

nora: One more: marketing wants a joint announcement window for any marketplace partners that finish early. If partners opt-in to the joint case study, we can feature them on the marketplace listing. Flagging product for PR coordination.

kevin: Good idea. We'll mark green partners that accept PR and move them to priority outreach.

isabelle: I'll also ask Support to create priority tickets for all red partners and open a shared triage board (kanban) so partners can attach PR links.

nora: If anyone finds partners with hard-pinned adapter versions that can't be updated, ping me immediately so we can propose runtime proxying. Otherwise we'll follow the schedule above. :thumbsup:

sam: Uploading migration guide + shim code in ~2h.

partner-bot: Reminder set for Fri 09:30.
